Limits, quotas & errors {{ds:component/chip|label=v2|variant=primary}}

{{ds:component/stat|value=1,000|label=requests / minute|description=Default rate limit for standard-tier API keys, per workspace.}}

For quota and billing information: See Quotas & billing to learn about plan tiers, monthly request limits, and what happens when you exceed your quota.

Rate limit headers

Every response includes X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset. A request over the limit returns 429 Too Many Requests with a Retry-After header.

Pagination

List endpoints (Pipelines, Connectors, Events) use cursor-based pagination — a departure from v1's offset-based pagination.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=list-response.json|language=json|code={\n "data": [ { "id": "pl_ingest_orders" } ],\n "next_cursor": "eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwfQ",\n "has_more": true\n}}}

v1 returned bare error strings. v2 always wraps errors in an error object with a stable code field — match on code, not on message text.
